name: full_validation/voc21/quality_tail12
algorithm_definition: Complete two-view quality_only; freeze ln_pre and all visual blocks except LayerNorm affine in the last 12 executed blocks; always adapt ln_post. The final reduced block's ln_2 stays frozen. Preserve all selected raw outputs and production aggregation. Cache only frozen prefix tokens and early selected RAW outputs for the identical original-image tensor within one episode, including proposal, adaptation and final evaluation. Diagnostic pixel interventions always run the full encoder. Freezing changes the algorithm; caching is exact only conditional on that frozen prefix, not equivalent to full-LN adaptation.
timing_scope: GPU-synchronized adaptation and final inference; excludes loading/scoring/model setup
selection: Image IDs chosen without labels or outcomes; batching recorded in config
